sources.quote: HD 16175 is a 7th magnitude G-type star with temperature about 6,000 K located 196 light-years away in the Andromeda constellation.

introduction.text: Gaia's parallax, brightness and spectrum give it 1.9 solar radii and 1.16 solar masses (FLAME) and 5,799 K at its surface (GSP-Phot).

sources.quote: This star is only visible through binoculars or better equipment; it is also 3.3 times more luminous, is 1.34 times more massive, and has a radius 1.66 times bigger than the Sun.
